en: Hetuduka, Maggārammaṇattika (The Dyad on Roots, the Triad on Having the Path as Object)

Dependent on a state that is a root-cause (*hetu*) and has the Path as its object (*maggārammaṇa*), there arises a state that is not a root-cause (*nahetu*) and does not have the Path as its object (*namaggārammaṇa*), by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). ... (In all cases, three.

Dependent on a state that is a root-cause and has the Path as its cause (*maggahetuka*), there arises a state that is not a root-cause and does not have the Path as its cause, by way of root-condition. ... (In all cases, three.

Dependent on a state that is a root-cause and has the Path as its predominance (*maggādhipati*), there arises a state that is not a root-cause and does not have the Path as its predominance, by way of root-condition. ... (Three for root-condition ... pe ... three for non-disappearance condition.)
